title: mksurfatlas
description: Creates an atlas using mris_make_template. The atlas can then be used to create the surface registration for each subject based on this atlas.

atlas.description: Save results to this file (tif file).
atlas.title: Atlas file

subjects.description: Subject(s) to process. Multiple subjects can be specified by repeating the flag.
subjects.title: Subjects

surfval.description: Surface values file. Looks for subject/surfvaldir/hemi.surfval.
surfval.title: Surface values file

surfvaldir.description: Directory for surface values; default is 'label'.
surfvaldir.title: Surface values directory
